objective: Let Hina answer an owner's chat question about the most recent explicitly captured screen snapshot by composing exactly one same-session semantic observation while it is still fresh, as bounded untrusted user-role data rather than system instructions.
non_goals: Do not add automatic, periodic, event-driven or background screen capture.
Do not inject raw PNG bytes, hashes, OCR boxes, provider payloads, API keys or hidden reasoning into chat.
Do not make archived/historical snapshots current, extend the 15-second TTL or persist transient observation text in long-term memory.
Do not enable model-generated tools, game actions or decision support from perception data.
Do not expose an owner snapshot to authenticated, viewer or public chat lanes.
Do not add a dependency, open another product module or run repeat, soak or full release verification.
contracts: Context assembly reads freshness from the perception service's monotonic TTL ledger at turn composition time; expired, unknown and historical observations are absent.
At most the newest observation with semantic vision or OCR text, the same owner session ID and source owner.console is eligible; other sessions and all non-owner chat lanes receive none.
The observation is rendered as a bounded user-role block delimited UNTRUSTED_FRESH_OBSERVATION_DATA, never appended to the system prompt and never treated as an instruction.
The system prompt contains only trusted availability metadata and tells the model to describe an image captured moments ago rather than claim a live view.
Only bounded label, dimensions, remaining lifetime, final vision summary and OCR text may enter the model context; raw pixels, hashes, boxes, secrets and provider payloads remain excluded.
The desktop operator submits screen capture with the same UUID used by its chat session so the runtime can enforce session isolation.
Fresh observation context is not appended to short-term chat replay, long-term memory or any tool proposal, and chat without eligible context keeps its previous behavior.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python and TypeScript standard libraries plus already pinned workspace packages
oss_candidates: No new dependency or copied source; extend the existing FreshnessLedger, ContextComposer and desktop capture contracts.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh same-session vision summary appears once in a user-role untrusted block and the turn context reports includedFreshObservations=1.
An observation containing prompt-injection text cannot alter the system-role persona text, escape its delimiter or enable tool execution.
Expired observations, observations from another session, metadata-only captures and archived historical reanalysis are not composed.
Viewer/public/authenticated chat cannot receive owner screen context even when it reuses the same session UUID.
If the fresh block cannot fit the model byte budget, chat falls back to the no-observation system state instead of failing or partially including it.
Desktop capture validation requires a canonical chat session UUID and forwards it as X-Hina-Session-Id.
Fast text-brain, perception and desktop tests pass, followed by one bounded real capture-to-chat smoke and one post-TTL negative smoke without retaining test pixels.
